title: Recharge a Salik Account
body: Through Salik Self Service on Salik Call Center: 800 SALIK (72545) Recharging account (without logging in) The customer enters the account number and PIN code or mobile number and plate number or tag number and plate number. The customer enters the recharge number. Once the recharge is confirmed, the Salik account balance is updated.
